title: Do not expose mutable TrustEntry security state to callers
description: P1 security: TrustStore.get(), verify_or_pin(), verify_peer(), add_trust_anchor(), rotate_key(), and list_entries() return the same mutable TrustEntry objects stored internally. Callers can then replace pubkey/IID/address, lower/raise trust_level, clear revoked, or mutate metadata without any derivation, authorization, rotation-signature, or persistence path; even a frozen store facade would be bypassed. Keep validated primitives private and return immutable detached views/copies, centralize all mutations behind checked methods, and add tests that attempted facade/nested metadata mutation cannot alter verification outcomes.
